## Tissue evidence
- **Sparse gland/tubule formation** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Low tubule score; concept model links this to invasive · Weak
- **Low benign stroma/fat** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Absence of benign stroma associated with invasive · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 3, 9, 10) · ↑ invasive · Above typical; small contribution · Validated
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 2) · ↑ invasive · Modest score; small contribution · Validated
- **Frequent mitoses** (regions 0, 3, 10) · ↑ invasive · Above typical, but spot check failed [F4] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47-0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI -0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown faithful. Mitoses and normal lobules (0/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Resampling degradation (severity 3) of this simulated section distorted features; reliability AUROC is only 0.69.
- The tubule score is off; it is text-prompt only and failed its caption-consistency check.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 3, 10**: Confirm mitotic figures by eye; concept spot check was 0/20.
2. **Region 5**: Check for tubules and benign stroma; scores are least negative here.
3. **Regions 0-4, 7-11**: Verify suggested tumor-at-margin call on all four edges [F7].
